How to get these drops

  1. Link your Crimson Desert account to Twitch — Connect your account ↗, or via Twitch Settings → Connections. One-time setup.
  2. Watch an eligible stream — Watch any Crimson Desert stream on Twitch ↗ that shows the Drops Enabled tag. Progress fills automatically while you watch. Make sure you're logged into Twitch.
  3. Claim your drop — When the progress bar fills, a notification appears in chat. Click it, or go to twitch.tv/drops/inventory ↗ to claim. You have ~24 hours before it expires.
  4. Receive in-game — Rewards appear in your Crimson Desert account within a few minutes. Restart the game if they don't show up.

Frequently Asked Questions

What Crimson Desert Twitch Drops are available?

Crimson Desert has 6 Twitch Drop rewards: Fair Wind Figurehead, Lantern & Meat Dish, Fair Wind Stern, Pirate Eyepatch & Sword, Fair Wind Sail, Pet Parrot in Pirate Hat. Active campaigns end November 11, 2026.

How do I get Crimson Desert Twitch Drops?

To earn Crimson Desert Twitch Drops: link your Twitch account to your Crimson Desert game account, watch an eligible stream for the required time, then claim your drops at twitch.tv/drops/inventory. Drops expire if unclaimed after the campaign ends.

When do the Crimson Desert Twitch Drop campaigns end?

The current Crimson Desert Twitch Drop campaigns end on November 11, 2026. Watch and claim before then — unclaimed drops expire with the campaign.

Which channels should I watch for Crimson Desert Twitch Drops?

Watch any Twitch channel streaming Crimson Desert while the campaign is active.
